title: new_employee_leave
policy_text: New employees can use monthly leave after one month from their start date

title: summer_vacation_approval
policy_text: Summer vacation can be used within the announced period after team approval

title: remaining_leave_lookup
policy_text: Remaining leave days are checked in the HR system

title: new_benefit_notice
policy_text: New benefit programs require HR confirmation until the official notice is posted

title: remote_work_request
policy_text: Remote work can be requested after checking the team schedule and security standards

title: equipment_request
policy_text: Work equipment is requested in the asset management system after department-head approval

title: expense_reimbursement
policy_text: Work expenses must be registered in the reimbursement system with receipts attached

title: training_budget
policy_text: Job training expenses can be reimbursed after prior approval and completion confirmation

title: security_incident
policy_text: If a security incident is suspected, report it to the security team immediately and keep related records

title: personal_data_access
policy_text: Personal data access is allowed only for business purposes and with approval records

title: customer_refund_exception
policy_text: Refund exceptions require customer-support leader approval and evidence records

title: system_access_request
policy_text: System access requests must leave the purpose and period and receive administrator approval
